subject.title: fix(agents): write unresumable notice to transcript for non-deliverable channels

question: Should WebChat's unresumable restart-recovery notice be persisted as a delivery-mirror assistant row in the session transcript when no outbound delivery channel exists?
rationale: The code path appears correct, but the behavior defines a durable session-history contract and affects recovery UX/state semantics, so maintainer intent is needed before merge.

options.title: Accept Guarded Transcript Notice

options.title: Require Live WebChat Proof First
options.body: Ask for a short restart/reconnect Control UI proof before merge while keeping the same implementation direction.

options.title: Defer To Broader Recovery Design
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want recover-and-confirm, restart deferral, or SQLite route migration to define the contract first.

recommendation.title: Accept Guarded Transcript Notice
recommendation.body: Land the current approach after resolving conflicts, preserving the target normalization and expectedSessionId guard.
